summary.text: Maria Diaz, a Republican, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 86 to Yudelka Tapia, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia, after having defeated Shery Olivo in the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists no prior elected office for her, and no biography or campaign materials were found.
